section.title: Introduction
section.paragraph: This Privacy Policy describes how Photo Cleaner: Storage Sweep (“Space Cleaner,” “the App,” “we,” or “us”) handles information when you use our Android application. The App helps you analyze storage, find similar photos and videos, compress media, manage files on your device, and optionally browse protected locations with root read-only access.

We designed the App for local processing: scanning, hashing, grouping, compression, and cleanup run on your device. We do not operate application servers that collect your photos, videos, files, contacts, or location. We do not use advertising SDKs or analytics SDKs.
By using the App, you agree to this Privacy Policy. Please also read our Terms of Service.

list.item: No account or login is required.
We do not sell your personal information.
Your media and files are processed on-device; we do not upload your library to our servers.
Network access is used only for Google Play Billing (purchases, subscriptions, and restore).
No ads and no third-party tracking for advertising.
Google Play processes payment data under Google’s own privacy policy.

section.title: Information We Do Not Collect on Our Servers
section.paragraph: We do not operate backend services that receive or store the following from you:

list.item: Photos, videos, audio, documents, or other file contents
File paths, folder structures, or storage scan results
Similarity groups, perceptual hashes, or compression outputs
Contacts, call logs, SMS, precise or coarse location, or calendar data
Advertising identifiers used for cross-app tracking
Crash or usage analytics sent to our servers (we do not operate such pipelines)

section.paragraph: For Google Play’s Data safety form, the App is intended to be declared as no data collected and no data shared by the developer for the App’s own services, except as described for purchases handled entirely by Google Play.

section.title: Information Stored on Your Device
section.paragraph: To provide features, the App may store small amounts of data locally on your phone or tablet, including:

list.item: Preferences: theme, font size, date format, whether to show hidden files, sort order memory, and similar UI settings (SharedPreferences).
Scan caches: fingerprints or metadata used to speed up similar photo and video grouping; stored in a local database on the device.
Free-tier counters: local counts for daily or batch limits on compression and similar-media cleanup when you are not a Pro subscriber.
Pro status cache: a local flag reflecting whether Google Play reports an active subscription or lifetime purchase, so Pro features can work offline after verification.

section.paragraph: This data stays on your device unless you uninstall the App, clear app storage, or delete it through your device settings. Uninstalling removes app-private storage; your personal files in shared storage are not deleted unless you delete them inside the App.

section.title: Permissions and How We Use Them
section.paragraph: The App requests Android permissions only for features you use. Denying a permission may limit a feature but does not block the entire App.

row.cell: READ_MEDIA_IMAGES / READ_MEDIA_VIDEO (Android 13+)
Scan photos and videos for Quick Clean, similar grouping, previews, and compression.
READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE / WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (older Android versions, scoped by maxSdkVersion)
Media and file access on devices that do not use the Android 13+ media permissions.
MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (All files access)
Full file manager (Files tab): browse, rename, move, copy, delete, and organize non-media files and hidden items. Core file-manager functionality.
INTERNET
Google Play Billing only: load products, complete purchases, acknowledge transactions, and restore purchases. Not used for scanning, ads, or analytics.
FOREGROUND_SERVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROCESSING
Show ongoing progress while image or video compression runs in the background.
POST_NOTIFICATIONS (Android 13+)
Display compression task progress in a notification when the service is active.
REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
When you explicitly choose to install an APK file from the file manager (user-initiated only).
SET_WALLPAPER
When you explicitly set an image as your wallpaper from the file browser.
FileProvider (component)
Securely share or open files with other apps using content URIs; does not upload data to us.
Optional root (su) read-only
If you enable root browsing on a rooted device, the App may run read-only shell commands to list protected paths. Root is optional, off by default, and we do not send root output to any server.

section.paragraph: We do not request location, contacts, phone, SMS, microphone, camera (for capture), or overlay permissions. We do not request READ_MEDIA_AUDIO as a default path; audio categorization may rely on all-files access when granted.

list.item: Quick Clean & similar media: reads media metadata and content on-device to find duplicates and similar items; deletion uses the system recycle bin when available.
Storage analysis: aggregates sizes and categories locally.
Compression: reads and writes files you select; output stays on your device unless you move or share it.
Apps list: uses standard package visibility (launcher apps) to show installed applications and storage impact—no QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.
Receive / open files: if another app sends a file to Space Cleaner, processing happens locally (e.g., save copy).

section.title: Purchases and Google Play
section.paragraph: Pro features (unlimited compression batches, higher similar-photo/video cleanup limits, and related benefits shown in the App) may require a subscription or one-time purchase through Google Play.

When you buy or restore a purchase, Google Play processes payment and entitlement. We receive only what Google Play’s Billing Library provides on-device (such as product IDs and purchase tokens) to unlock Pro. We do not receive your full card number. Google’s privacy policy applies to payment processing: https://policies.google.com/privacy
The App may display USD reference prices (for example, weekly, monthly, annual, or lifetime amounts). The actual charge amount and currency are always shown on the Google Play checkout screen.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel in Google Play. Trial length, if offered, is shown on Google Play before you confirm (the App may reference a trial such as 3 days when configured in Play Console).

section.title: Third Parties

list.item: Google Play Services / Billing: purchase and subscription management.
Open-source libraries (e.g., image loading, UI components) bundled in the App; they run locally and are not used by us to collect personal data on our servers.

section.paragraph: We do not integrate advertising networks or third-party analytics that profile you across apps.

section.title: Security
section.paragraph: Because processing is local, protecting your device (screen lock, avoiding untrusted root mods, keeping Android updated) is important. We use Android platform APIs for scoped storage, recycle-bin deletion where supported, and FileProvider for safer sharing. No security method is perfect; use the App at your discretion when deleting or compressing files.

section.title: Children
section.paragraph: The App is a general utility not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children on our servers. If you believe a child has contacted us in error, email us at the address below.

section.title: International Users
section.paragraph: The App is offered primarily in English for users worldwide. Data described here is processed on your device. If you use the App in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or other regions with privacy laws, you retain rights under applicable law; because we do not operate a data-collection backend for file content, many requests may simply confirm that your files were never transmitted to us.

section.title: Changes to This Policy
section.paragraph: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect App changes, permission updates, or legal requirements. We will revise the “Last updated” date. Material changes may also be described in the App or on the hosted policy page. Continued use after the effective date means you accept the updated policy.
